name: NVD CVE API 2.0 - recently added KEV
notes: CVEs added to CISA KEV in window (~160KB/15 items). Update date range daily. Unkeyed NVD limit ~5 req/30s. Ask: CVE id, vendor, description, cisaExploitAdd.

name: NVD CVE API 2.0 - new CRITICAL CVEs
notes: Critical CVEs published in window (~20KB/10 items; check totalResults). Update dates daily. Ask: id, published, first description, baseScore.

name: GitHub Advisory DB - critical reviewed
notes: Newest critical reviewed advisories (~100KB). Unauthenticated limit 60 req/h. Ask: ghsa_id, summary, ecosystem/package, published_at.

name: SANS Internet Storm Center diary
notes: Daily handler diaries on active exploitation/scans (~41KB). Ask: titles + dates of newest 10 items.

name: GitHub Advisory DB - malware (all ecosystems)
notes: Newest malicious-package advisories, npm+PyPI etc (~15KB). Several per day. 60 req/h unauth. Ask: summary, package/ecosystem, published_at.

name: GitHub Advisory DB - PyPI malware
notes: Newest PyPI malicious-package advisories (~20KB). Change ecosystem=npm for npm. Ask: summary, published_at.

name: Socket.dev research blog
notes: Atom, ~108KB; npm/PyPI campaign write-ups, several posts/week. Ask: newest 10 titles+dates+one-line summary.

name: StepSecurity blog
notes: ~99KB; CI/CD and package compromises (e.g. GitHub Actions, PyPI). Ask: newest 10 titles+dates.

name: ransomware.live recent victims
notes: ~82KB, newest first, fields victim/group/country/attackdate. Updated continuously. Ask: first 25 victims, group, country, date.

name: RansomLook recent posts
notes: ~5KB, last 10 leak-site posts with post_title/group_name/discovered. Raise number for more but size grows.

name: RansomLook RSS last entries
notes: ~28KB; titles are 'Victim By group'. Cross-check against ransomware.live. Ask: titles+dates, count per group.

name: The DFIR Report
notes: ~14KB; few posts/month; intrusion/ransomware case studies. Ask: titles+dates of latest 5.

name: BleepingComputer
notes: ~13KB, ~15 newest items, many per day; breaches, ransomware, malware. Ask: titles+pubDate, flag breach/ransomware/supply-chain.

name: The Record (Recorded Future News)
notes: ~5KB, newest items; breaches, ransomware, nation-state policy. Items use CDATA titles. Ask: titles+dates+one-line descriptions.

name: Have I Been Pwned - latest breach
notes: ~1.7KB, single newest breach added (name, domain, BreachDate, AddedDate, PwnCount). Cheap daily check; full /breaches is 1.1MB.

name: Palo Alto Unit 42
notes: ~25KB; APT/campaign and malware research, several posts/week. Ask: titles+dates, attributed actors.

name: ESET WeLiveSecurity
notes: ~70KB; ESET Research APT reports mixed with consumer posts. Ask: only APT/state-linked items (titles, actor, date).

name: CISA News
notes: ~5KB; joint CISA/FBI/NSA advisories incl. state-actor and ransomware (#StopRansomware). Ask: titles+dates.

name: SecurityWeek
notes: ~12KB; vulns, breaches, APT news daily. Ask: titles+dates, tag category.

name: The Hacker News
notes: ~60KB; broad daily coverage incl. exploited zero-days, supply chain, APTs. Ask: titles+dates, tag category.
